article.title: 研究補讀：EditAgent以專用工具與驗證紀錄處理圖像修改
article.title_en: Research review: EditAgent routes image edits through specialist tools
article.summary: 10月29日提交的EditAgent論文提出，按修改任務選工具，並附上驗證紀錄。
article.summary_en: The October 29 EditAgent preprint proposes task-based tool routing and verification records.
highlights: 候選結果並行產生，再集中比較。
研究涵蓋兩款開放權重編輯器及三個基準。
highlights_en: Candidates are generated in parallel and compared together.
The study covers two open-weight editors and three benchmarks.
article.why: 創意團隊可參考其把生成與檢查分開的設計，而非一直重試同一工具。
article.why_en: Creative teams can distinguish generation from verification when designing workflows.
article.next_step: 把品牌字樣、產品細節及局部修改分列為驗收項目。
article.next_step_en: Define separate checks for brand text, product details and local edits.
article.detail: EditAgent研究把圖像編輯視為多步驟任務，按每一步需要選擇通用或專用方法，並為候選結果附上驗證紀錄，供視覺語言模型判斷。這類模型能同時處理圖片與文字。論文屬研究預印本，本報道只整理其方法與評估範圍，並未確認已成為商用產品，也未實測品牌素材或宣稱可節省製作成本。
article.detail_en: The method selects general or specialist editors at each step and gives visual-language judges verification records. This is a research preprint, not an announced commercial editing service. Brand-asset performance and production savings were not tested here.
